fluff.overview: Infantry within the Legiones Marianes form the backbone of planetary garrison and territorial defense, freeing the Hegemony's limited BattleMech assets for offensive operations and prestige assignments. A triplus contubernium, or triple tent-group, combines three squads of ten soldiers mounted on light vehicles. Motorized triplus contubernia provide fast-moving infantry support for Marian armored columns and conduct sweeps across open terrain where foot infantry cannot keep pace. Support squads operate portable machine guns that deliver sustained automatic fire, providing suppression capability against enemy infantry and light vehicles.
